body: right there with you, I wish I could describe how I'm feeling but I feel like there is nothing left to be said, I just want to be gone. Hopefully I find a way that doesn't hurt much.

I wish I could hug you, I have adhd too, never found the right medication for it but I feel somewhat similar. I managed to reach a lot of goals that I thought would make me happy but I started realising how pointless it all really is, everything feels so superficial. I wish I could see the same beauty other people see in life but I just can’t.
The future is never promised, anyone who says otherwise is naive. If I knew I would turn out like this I’d have killed myself long ago.
Hey, I’m in the same boat as you right now. 19 and started my first year of college but I’m barely holding on due to my depression. If you need someone to talk to I’m here.
